_comment: plan-faction-flips chunk 3 (D8/L-L): the SECOND charm, and the acceptance test for the faction-scope seam — it exists so that reaching a different faction is a JSON file rather than a Go change. Mechanically identical to charm-beast.json; only the allowlist and the tuning differ. An elemental pet is deliberately the shorter, costlier one: the elemental faction contains the game's other charmable elite (greater-fire-elemental, D12) and elementals hit harder than wildlife, so the same enslave fantasy is priced higher.
